cards.title: Present Simple
cards.formula: I/you/we/they + V · he/she/it + V-s  ·  факты, привычки, простые действия

cards.title: Present: to be (am / is / are)
cards.formula: I am · he/she/it is · you/we/they are  ·  кто/где/какой
examples: The hotel is near the beach.
cards.mistake: I is tired. / She are here.

cards.title: Present Continuous
cards.formula: am/is/are + V-ing  ·  прямо сейчас в процессе
examples: She is going to the gate.

cards.title: Past Simple
cards.formula: V-ed / went, had, was…  ·  вчера, в поездке
examples: I went to the market yesterday.

cards.title: he / she / it + -s
cards.formula: I/you/we/they → go, want · he/she/it → goes, wants, has

cards.title: Артикли a / the / ∅
cards.formula: a = один считаемый · the = тот самый · категория/страна часто без a
cards.mistake: a Thailand / a help / to airport

cards.title: in / on / at
cards.formula: in = внутри · on = на поверхности · at = у точки/места
cards.mistake: on the lobby / on the market
